author: emilyddoan

title: Don’t use or buy
body:
Terrible experience, borderlining scam. Immediately force you buy a hefty subscription even before getting in the app. They do this trick where they show a limited offer (with 1m) countdown for 50% off lifetime subscription. I almost fell for it.
The app itself is pretty basic and unfriendly. E.g. no feature to choose the start date of your habit; and why is the first home tab is the premade challenges? It’s not like your user want a new 10day challenges every time they open the app?
author: Tin137

title: Charged twice
body: I got charged twice. The page opened to three choices of subscription and I chose the lifetime access. Then a pop-up showed that I get a 50%off for this deal if I subscribe within one hour. So I did. My account is now showing me that I got charged for the original subscription price + the 50% price. I’m trying to send email through the support but just showing a pop-up message, “Failed to send email” 😫
